name: Vampires
description: Vampires are the blood-drinking creatures of Innistrad, created by Markov and the demon Shilgengar with an angel's blood, whose bloodlines include the Markov and Voldaren.

description_citations.text: "The Lunarch's Journal" by Colin Kawakami. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Aug 2014.

summary.text: Vampires are the blood-drinking creatures of Innistrad, created by Markov and the demon Shilgengar with an angel's blood, whose bloodlines include the Markov and Voldaren.

bio.text: A journal reveals that vampires were created by humans, when Markov and the demon Shilgengar used an angel's blood after trapping and draining Marycz.

citations.text: "The Lunarch's Journal" by Colin Kawakami. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Aug 2014.

bio.text: The same journal says Sorin created Avacyn to hold the vampires in check and that the church keeps humans as livestock, never able to defeat the vampires.

citations.text: "The Lunarch's Journal" by Colin Kawakami. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Aug 2014.

bio.text: In a bog, vampires attack Nissa and Mazik, and Nissa summons a land elemental and kills the vampire leader with vines.

citations.text: "The Mystery of Markov Manor" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Mar 2016.

timeline.summary: The native peoples of Zendikar, the Kor, merfolk and vampires, try to understand the Eldrazi and how to defeat them.
timeline.quote: The Kor, merfolk, and vampires all tried to understand and figure out what the Eldrazi were and how could they defeat them.

citation.text: "First Week's Flavor". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Jun 2010. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: On Innistrad hedonistic vampires stalk the shadows, and the full moon can transform a villager into a werewolf.
timeline.quote: hedonistic vampires stalk the shadows to quench their thirst, and the full moon can transform a simple villager into a savage werewolf

citation.text: "Innistrad", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Vampires follow the ritual of siring: a vampire introduces its blood to a victim, who must drink the sire's blood before the next new moon or die.
timeline.quote: A newly anointed victim who doesn't drink the sire's blood before the next new moon will die.

citation.work: A Planeswalker's Guide to Innistrad: Stensia and Vampires
citation.text: "A Planeswalker's Guide to Innistrad: Stensia and Vampires". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Nov 2011. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Cosper Lowe begins to realize the disappearances of young women who liked him mean a vampire is infatuated with him.
timeline.quote: It has just started to dawn on Cosper that this means he's the target of a vampire's infatuation.

citation.work: A Planeswalker's Guide to Innistrad: Stensia and Vampires
citation.text: "A Planeswalker's Guide to Innistrad: Stensia and Vampires". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Nov 2011. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Avacyn disappears, weakening the holy symbols' power over vampires.
timeline.quote: although their ability to do so has significantly diminished in the last year (because of Avacyn's disappearance).

citation.work: A Planeswalker's Guide to Innistrad: Stensia and Vampires
citation.text: "A Planeswalker's Guide to Innistrad: Stensia and Vampires". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Nov 2011. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Monsters learn humanity's defenses are thin and the slain begin to rise again.
timeline.quote: Apparently slain werewolves have begun to stagger back to their feet

citation.work: A Backstory Update for Dark Ascension
citation.text: "A Backstory Update for Dark Ascension". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Jan 2012. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: The journal reveals vampires were created by humans: Markov and the demon Shilgengar used an angel's blood, after trapping and draining Marycz.
timeline.quote: Markov and his sons trapped the angel Marycz in his laboratory and exsanguinated her

citation.text: "The Lunarch's Journal" by Colin Kawakami. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Aug 2014.

timeline.summary: The journal says Sorin created Avacyn to hold the vampires in check and that the church keeps humans as livestock, never able to defeat them; Dovid concludes his faith is a lie.
timeline.quote: We are livestock. We are unwitting participants in our own cultivation.

citation.text: "The Lunarch's Journal" by Colin Kawakami. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Aug 2014.

timeline.summary: Vampires attack in the bog and Nissa leads Mazik to flight along the stream, but Mazik is separated and trapped in a tree.
timeline.quote: Five vampiric horrors loped after them.

citation.text: "Nissa's Origin: Home" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Jul 2015.

timeline.summary: Nissa unexpectedly summons a huge land elemental, controls it, and kills the vampire leader with vines.
timeline.quote: they pierced the vampire straight through his heart.

citation.text: "Nissa's Origin: Home" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Jul 2015.

timeline.summary: Jace finds a great hall of floating rubble with dozens of petrified vampires embedded in the stone.
timeline.quote: Dozens and dozens of them, trapped and petrified and encased in the stone.

citation.text: "The Mystery of Markov Manor" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Mar 2016.

timeline.summary: Jace experiences the dead man's memory of vampires grabbing him, with Edgar Markov approaching.
timeline.quote: I step back and suddenly there are hands all around me, clutching at me.

citation.text: "The Mystery of Markov Manor" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Mar 2016.

timeline.summary: Jace witnesses a vision of Edgar Markov and twelve vampires opening an angel's veins and drinking her silver blood at an altar, perhaps the birth of Innistrad's vampires.
timeline.quote: The knife slashes and glowing silver blood erupts from the angel's neck.

citation.text: "The Mystery of Markov Manor" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Mar 2016.

timeline.summary: Jace deduces that Jenrik brought the journal, was about to be caught by the vampires, and that someone tore the castle apart and trapped them all in the walls.
timeline.quote: Jenrik came to the castle carrying the journal

citation.text: "The Mystery of Markov Manor" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Mar 2016.

timeline.summary: Sorin walks through Olivia Voldaren's masked ballroom to confront her.
timeline.quote: A hundred or more pairs of eyes watched him from behind elegant masks as he made his way across the ballroom.

citation.text: "Promises Old and New" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Apr 2016.

timeline.summary: Sorin cuts down five of Olivia's vampires and blasts the last, a duelist, to ash with a clenched fist.
timeline.quote: his assailant's body burst apart in a scattering of ashes

citation.text: "Promises Old and New" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Apr 2016.

timeline.summary: Sorin and Olivia lead the Voldaren vampire army off to battle Nahiri, not to help the people.
timeline.quote: The vampire army marched off down the hill, swords and pikes and red-hot priest symbols held high

citation.text: "Innistrad's Last Hope" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: Sorin's vampire army arrives with banners and knights opposite the manor.
timeline.quote: The first of Sorin's forces to arrive were the banners, ancient cloths that hung from black wooden poles

citation.text: "Campaign of Vengeance" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Nahiri kills a white-armored vampire and many others in the melee in the great hall.
timeline.quote: the vampire fell silent when a marble corbel smashed into her mouth, pulverizing those grotesque teeth.

citation.text: "Campaign of Vengeance" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Olivia arrives overhead with vampire knights and says she cannot allow Nahiri her revenge.
timeline.quote: But he's also earned my help, so I can't allow you your revenge.

citation.text: "Campaign of Vengeance" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Olivia and her vampires wade into the monsters while Sorin pursues Nahiri through the floating ruins.
timeline.quote: By the time Nahiri was among the unmoored, broken remnants of the manor's vaulted ceiling, Sorin was on her heels.

citation.text: "Campaign of Vengeance" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Thalia and Olivia agree that vampires and humans will not harm each other until the fight is over.
timeline.quote: No vampire bite or blade will draw human blood until this fight is through, Heir of Saint Traft.

citation.work: Saint Traft and the Flight of Nightmares
citation.text: "Saint Traft and the Flight of Nightmares" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Thalia's army passes through Thraben's Outer Wall and fights alongside vampires through the streets.
timeline.quote: They were fighting shoulder to shoulder with vampires now, making their way through the streets of the city.

citation.work: Saint Traft and the Flight of Nightmares
citation.text: "Saint Traft and the Flight of Nightmares" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Stromkirk members borrow from blood tithes with House Voldaren ascendant.
timeline.quote: With House Voldaren ascendant, some members of the Stromkirk line took it upon themselves to "borrow" from the blood tithes.

citation.text: Stromkirk Bloodthief (Innistrad: Midnight Hunt, 2021), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The Voldaren demand blood offerings from villagers.
timeline.quote: The Voldaren have begun demanding blood offerings from the villagers in their territory.

citation.text: Vampire Interloper (Innistrad: Midnight Hunt, 2021), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Vampires of every bloodline gather at the wedding, the event of the century.
timeline.quote: Vampires from every bloodline mingled together

citation.text: Wedding Festivity (Innistrad: Crimson Vow Promos, 2021), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Dorothea says she cannot rest while a Voldaren lives.
timeline.quote: Every day a Voldaren draws breath is a day I cannot rest.

citation.text: Dorothea, Vengeful Victim (Innistrad: Crimson Vow Promos, 2021), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Geists light the Voldaren fortress as they seek a way out.
timeline.quote: The towers and catwalks of the Voldaren fortress are lit by the lanterns of geists endlessly seeking a way out.

citation.text: Wanderlight Spirit (Innistrad: Crimson Vow, 2021), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Arlinn voices her opinion before the Voldaren-Markov union can proceed.
timeline.quote: Arlinn made her opinion known.

citation.text: Sure Strike (Innistrad: Crimson Vow, 2021), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Summoned by Olivia, the Voldaren march with the Markov remnant against Nahiri and her Eldrazi.
timeline.quote: the Voldaren vampires marched alongside the Markov remnant into battle against Nahiri

citation.text: "Voldaren", section "Eldritch Moon". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After the Travails, the Voldaren demand a Blood Tithe from villagers.
timeline.quote: the Voldaren have begun demanding blood offerings, the "Blood Tithe", from the villagers in their territory

citation.text: "Voldaren", section "Midnight Hunt and Crimson Vow". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Olivia stages a wedding with Edgar Markov to control Innistrad; Sorin, the Gatewatch, Sigarda and Tovolar's werewolves foil her and many Voldaren die.
timeline.quote: Her plan was foiled by Sorin Markov , the Gatewatch , Sigarda and Tovolar 's werewolves.

citation.text: "Voldaren", section "Midnight Hunt and Crimson Vow". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
